;International Relations
*[[Pakistan–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Department of State|U.S. State Department]] reinstates [[Pakistan]] into [[International Military Education and Training]] program. It was suspended in August 2018 as part of the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]]'s pressure to have it crack down on [[Islamism|Islamist]] militants. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-pakistan/u-s-to-resume-military-training-program-for-pakistan-state-department-idUSKBN1YO03S?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Maguindanao massacre]]
**A court in the [[Philippines]] finds 28 people, including former Mayor [[Andal Ampatuan Jr.]] and his brother, former Governor [[Zaldy Ampatuan]], guilty of [[murder]] for their roles in the Maguindanao massacre, and sentences them to [[life imprisonment]] (40 years). [https://www.rappler.com/nation/247380-ampatuan-brothers-guilty-ampatuan-maguindanao-massacre-case (Rappler)]
**Mayor Sajid Ampatuan, also a brother of Mayor Andal Ampatuan Jr., and 55 others are acquitted. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/247380-ampatuan-brothers-guilty-ampatuan-maguindanao-massacre-case (Rappler)]
*[[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis]], [[April 2019 Spanish general election]]
**[[President of Catalonia]] [[Quim Torra]] is sentenced by the [[High Court of Justice of Catalonia]] to a year and a half of disqualification (inhabilitación) from exercising the powers of elected office, in addition to a fine of 30,000€ for disobeying the [[Junta Electoral Central|Central Electoral Board]] by not withdrawing partisan symbols in the [[Palau de la Generalitat de Catalunya|Palau de la Generalitat]] and not guaranteeing the institution's neutrality during the [[April 2019 Spanish general election|April election]] campaign. Torra can appeal the ruling. [https://elpais.com/ccaa/2019/12/19/catalunya/1576750819_163784.html (''El País'')]
*[[Trial of Catalonia independence leaders]], [[2019 European Parliament election]]
**The [[European Court of Justice]] determines that jailed former [[Vice President of Catalonia]] [[Oriol Junqueras]] had immunity as an elected [[Member of the European Parliament|MEP]], despite being unable to take up his seat, as the [[Spanish Supreme Court]] had ruled due to his then-provisional prison situation. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/19/jailed-catalan-leader-oriol-junqueras-had-immunity-as-mep-court-rules (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Moscow FSB headquarters shooting]]
**Two people are killed and four injured in a [[mass shooting]] outside [[Russia]]'s [[Federal Security Service]] [[headquarters]] on [[Moscow]]'s [[Lubyanka Square]]. The shooter is also killed. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-russia-shooting/russia-names-gunman-behind-moscow-shooting-death-toll-rises-to-two-idUKKBN1YO0V0?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Citizenship Amendment Act protests]]
**Thousands of demonstrators take to the streets in various parts of [[India]] to protest the [[Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2019]]. Some are arrested, and internet service is shut down in many parts of the country. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/hundreds-protest-against-citizenship-act-citizens-list-in-mumbais-august-kranti-maidan-2151411?trendingnow (ndtv)]
**Three people are killed in violent clashes between protesters and police in [[Mangalore]] and [[Lucknow]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-50833361 (BBC News)]
*The [[Supreme Tribunal of Justice (Venezuela)|Venezuelan Supreme Court]] overturns a rule pertaining to the opposition-led [[National Assembly (Venezuela)|National Assembly]], which allowed members of the Assembly to vote ''in absentia'' due to large numbers of exiled opposition politicians. [https://news.yahoo.com/venezuelan-court-overturns-congress-decision-201022764.html (Yahoo!)]
*The [[Parliament of Lebanon]] nominates former [[Ministry of Education and Higher Education (Lebanon)|Education Minister]] [[Hassan Diab (minister)|Hassan Diab]] as [[Prime Minister of Lebanon|Prime Minister]]. [[President of Lebanon|President]] [[Michel Aoun]] tasks him with forming a new [[Council of Ministers of Lebanon|government]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/hezbollah-backed-hassan-diab-lebanon-pm-191219155153401.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2020 Labour Party leadership election (UK)|2020 Labour Party leadership election]]
**[[Official Opposition Shadow Cabinet (United Kingdom)|Shadow]] [[HM Treasury|Treasury Minister]] [[Clive Lewis (politician)|Clive Lewis]] announces his candidacy to succeed [[Jeremy Corbyn]] as [[Leader of the Labour Party (UK)|Leader]] of the [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]]. He is the second person to make this announcement, after [[Shadow Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs|Shadow Foreign Secretary]] [[Emily Thornberry]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-50861140 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Algerian presidential election]]
**[[Abdelmadjid Tebboune]] is sworn in as [[President of Algeria]], the first after 20 years of [[Abdelaziz Bouteflika]] regime. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/algeria-swears-president-opposition-debates-response-191219110029526.html (Al Jazeera)]
;Science and technology
*Scientists discover a 386 million-year-old [[Petrified wood|fossil forest]] at a [[sandstone]] [[quarry]] in [[Cairo, New York|Cairo]], [[New York (state)|New York]], making it the oldest known fossil forest in the world. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2019/dec/19/worlds-oldest-known-fossil-forest-found-in-new-york-quarry (''The Guardian'')]
